itineraries.title: Upper Assam in 4 days: Jorhat tea, Majuli and Sivasagar
itineraries.summary: Tea country around Jorhat and the Tocklai tea museum, two days on Majuli among the satras and mask-makers, then the Ahom monuments of Sivasagar.
itineraries.seoTitle: Upper Assam 4-Day Itinerary: Jorhat, Majuli, Sivasagar
itineraries.seoDescription: 4 days in Upper Assam: Jorhat's tea gardens and Tocklai, the ferry to Majuli's satras and Samaguri masks, and Sivasagar's Siva Dol and Rang Ghar.

plan.overview: A slower, cultural loop in Upper Assam. Fly into Jorhat, the 'cultural capital of Assam' with 135 tea gardens, cross by ferry to Majuli — the world's largest inland river island and the heart of Assam's satras — and finish among the Ahom palaces and temples of Sivasagar. October to April is the season; time it for Jorhat's Tea Festival or Majuli's Raas Mahotsav, both in November.
plan.season: October–April; November for the Tea Festival and Raas Mahotsav
plan.transport: Hired car; bus-and-ferry or RORO ferry to Majuli.

prep.title: Season
prep.body: October to April for Jorhat; October to March for Sivasagar. November brings the Tea Festival and Majuli's Raas Mahotsav.

guides.title: How to reach and get around Assam
guides.summary: Assam's airports at Guwahati, Jorhat and Dibrugarh, official road distances to Kaziranga, the ferry to Majuli, and Assam Tourism's lodges along the way.
guides.seoTitle: How to Reach Assam and Get Around: Kaziranga, Majuli
guides.seoDescription: Getting to and around Assam: Guwahati, Jorhat and Dibrugarh airports, official distances to Kaziranga, the Majuli ferry from Nimati Ghat and state-run lodges.

body.intro: Assam stretches along the Brahmaputra, and most trips run east from Guwahati along NH 37 to Kaziranga, Jorhat and Upper Assam. Three airports cover the state, and the official Kaziranga park site publishes road distances to its main hub, Kohora.

items.title: Guwahati
items.body: Borjhar airport, about 28 km from the city, is the primary airport of Northeast India.

items.title: Jorhat
items.body: Rowriah airport connects to major cities; Kohora (Kaziranga) is 105 km, about 2 hours.

items.title: Dibrugarh
items.body: Mohanbari airport, about 15 km from the city, has flights to Delhi, Kolkata and Guwahati.

sections.heading: Kaziranga safari fees and rules
sections.text: Park entry is ₹100 for Indians and ₹650 for foreigners per trip; jeep hire in the Central (Kohora) range is ₹2,200, plus a ₹300 road toll per vehicle. Inside the park, wear sober colours, stay with the armed guards or guides, keep silent and keep to 20 km/h; walking is allowed only on permitted trails.

sections.heading: To Majuli
sections.text: Majuli, the world's largest inland river island, is reached from Jorhat: bus and ferry from Nimati Steamer Ghat take over three hours with changes, and a RORO ferry also runs.

sections.heading: Where the state-run lodges are
sections.text: Assam Tourism runs lodges including the Prashanti Tourist Lodge on Station Road in Guwahati, the Aranya Tourist Lodge at Kohora near Kaziranga, the Prashanti Tourist Lodge on M.G. Road in Jorhat and the Prashanti Eco Tourism Resort at Kamalabari on Majuli.

checklist: Book Kaziranga safaris only on kazirangasafari.in.
Allow a half-day for the Majuli crossing.
Rail: Jorhat Town and Mariani Junction serve Jorhat.

body.intro: Assam's travel season is the cool, dry half of the year. The monsoon brings heavy rain from June to September, and Kaziranga's western range floods at its peak.

items.title: Jorhat
items.body: October to April; the Tea Festival is held each November.

items.title: Dibrugarh
items.body: October to March; winter is mild at about 10–25 °C.

sections.heading: Kaziranga
